mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job_templates WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_templates (company_id, title, description, category_id, image_url, province, city, district, address, latitude, longitude) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{imageUrl}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude})
